results.description:
FamilyWatcher helps you look after an aging parent, even from far away. With their permission, their iPhone and Apple Watch share heart rate, sleep, steps and location with your family. You can be alerted to a fall, a reading past a limit you set or when they leave home.

HOW IT WORKS
One app, two roles. Install FamilyWatcher on your iPhone or iPad and on your parent's iPhone.
1. On their iPhone, choose "I'm a senior", agree to what will be shared, allow Apple Health and location access, then tap "Get your code". No email or password needed.
2. On yours, choose "I'm part of the support network", create your account and enter the 6-digit code. Your parent can read it to you or share it as a link.
3. Add their photo and details, then turn on notifications.
Heart rate, blood oxygen, sleep and fall alerts need an Apple Watch. Without one, the family sees mainly steps and location.

WHAT YOUR FAMILY CAN SEE
• Heart rate, blood oxygen, respiratory (breathing) rate, steps, sleep stages and falls
• Graphs by day, week, month and 6 months
• Phone and watch battery, and when they last updated
• Their latest location on a map (not live tracking)

ALERTS
• Set high or low limits for heart rate, blood oxygen and respiratory rate, and choose who is notified.
• A fall alert is set up when you connect your parent. Add one in Manage Alerts for anyone you invite later.
• Set a safe zone around their home. Your family is notified when your parent leaves it and when they're back.
• Alerts go to your family, not to your parent or to emergency services.

MEDICATIONS AND REMINDERS
• Add medications with the dose, strength, type, half doses and a photo of the pill.
• Add other reminders for one time, every day or chosen days of the week.
• Your parent taps Taken or Not taken on the notification, and it shows on a shared calendar. One family member can be notified too.
• Your parent can add their own reminders too.

CARE AS A TEAM
• Send a hug: a notification that says you're thinking of them. They can send one back.
• Invite relatives with a link to see the same dashboard, map and reminders.
• Add both parents, or another older relative.

WORKS WITH APPLE HEALTH AND APPLE WATCH
FamilyWatcher works with the Apple Health app. With your parent's permission, it reads their data from Apple Health without changing it and shares it with your family. You'll need:
• iOS 15.6 or later. Your parent needs an iPhone.
• An Apple Watch with watchOS 11.1 or later and FamilyWatcher's watch app, for heart rate, blood oxygen and respiratory rate. Not every model measures every reading; blood oxygen isn't offered in every region.
• Fall Detection turned on in Apple Watch settings, for fall alerts.

Carez is a caregiving support app designed to help families and caregivers easily organize and share daily care-related information.
Even without saying “I already took care of it,” everyone can stay informed about the day’s caregiving. Carez helps families share that sense of reassurance together.

Caregiving involves many things to keep track of every day — meals, medications, bathroom visits, physical condition, appointments, and important notes.
“Did they already take their medicine?”
“How were they feeling today?”
“Did I forget to tell the family something important?”
Carez was created to reduce those small worries and hassles by making it easier for everyone involved in caregiving to stay on the same page.

“They keep repeating the same story over and over,”
“I’m exhausted from being woken up multiple times during the night,”
or “I don’t know how to ask my family for help,”
you can casually talk with others in similar situations.
Even if someone doesn’t leave a reply, they can still send a simple “I understand” reaction, creating a space where caregivers don’t have to feel alone.

Caregiving is not something anyone should carry alone.
Carez connects the people who record, support, and look after loved ones, helping make daily caregiving feel a little more manageable and reassuring.

Recommended for people who:

• Want to share caregiving information with family members  
• Want to keep clear daily care records  
• Want to manage medications and appointments more easily  
• Want to stay informed about family members living apart  
• Want smoother communication and handoffs between caregivers  
• Want to reduce caregiving stress and anxiety  
• Want to talk with others facing similar caregiving challenges  

With Carez, make caregiving records easier to understand.
Make family communication simpler.
Make daily caregiving feel more reassuring.

results.description:
Your group text is not a care plan.

Most families caring for an aging parent rely on scattered texts, missed calls, and one person quietly carrying most of it — while everyone else wants to help but doesn't know how.

FairNest fixes that. A Nest is your family's private space for one person's care — every task, appointment, expense, and covered day in one place, so the whole family can show up, not just one person.

-------------------------------
WHAT YOUR NEST CAN DO
-------------------------------

TASKS
Assign medication pickups, doctor visits, grocery runs, and therapy sessions. Everyone sees what's done and what still needs attention.

CALENDAR
One shared calendar for the whole Nest. Appointments, specialist visits, and care events — visible to everyone, always up to date.

EXPENSES
Log and split care costs fairly. Track prescriptions, transport, groceries, and medical bills. See who's covered what and settle up without awkward conversations.

COVERAGE SCHEDULE
Who's with Mom on Tuesday? FairNest shows it. Claim days, split mornings and evenings, and make sure there's never a gap nobody noticed.

FAIRNESS DASHBOARD
A clear, judgment-free view of how the load is shared — tasks completed, expenses covered, days claimed. Not a scoreboard. Just visibility.

DOCUMENTS
Insurance cards, medical records, advance directives, legal documents — shared with the whole Nest and available when it matters most.

CARE PASSPORT
Every allergy, medication, doctor, and emergency contact in one place. Share it instantly by text when someone else needs to step in.

-------------------------------
BUILT FOR FAMILIES CARING FOR
-------------------------------

- Aging parents and grandparents
- Seniors living at home or transitioning to care
- Adults with disabilities or chronic illness
- Children with complex care needs
- Anyone whose care takes a village

-------------------------------
PLANS
-------------------------------

Free — one Nest with 2 caregivers plus your care recipient.
Family — up to 5 caregivers plus your care recipient.
Extended Family — up to 15 caregivers plus your care recipient.

The Care Passport, emergency details and Care History are included on every plan.

-------------------------------

Care is hard. Coordinating it shouldn't be.

FamilyCare Senior helps families and caregivers organize older adult care routines in a shared, simple, and secure environment.

With the app, you can create older adult profiles, record medications and schedules, organize appointments, exams, tasks, care shifts, health documents, expenses, shopping lists, nutrition menus, and conversations between family members and caregivers.

The Daily Board brings together the main items for the day, such as medications, appointments, pending tasks, care shifts, and upcoming expenses, helping everyone understand what needs attention.

The Care Schedule and Calendar let you view appointments, shifts, and important events, with the option to attach files or images when needed. The app can also send reminders and notifications to support the family routine.

You can also invite family members, caregivers, and the older adult to join the care group, with appropriate permissions for each person. Caregivers can collaborate in the routine, record expenses, and follow information according to the access defined by the main responsible person.

In health documents, the app lets you store exams, prescriptions, reports, certificates, and other important files. When available in the active plan, AI analysis can help summarize and explain documents in a more accessible way.

The Nutrition area lets you record menus, notes, photos, and files related to the older adult’s meals, keeping this information available for the family and authorized caregivers.

FamilyCare Senior does not replace medical advice, emergency care, or professional evaluation. The app is a family organization tool designed to support daily care follow-up.

Hyey — “Have You Eaten Yet?” — is how so many families say I love you. But when the people who love someone most are spread across different schedules, different cities, and different caregivers, that simple question gets a lot harder to answer. Hyey fixes that.

Hyey is the coordination app built for families managing home care for an aging parent. Whether you’re the primary caregiver or one of several people sharing the load, Hyey gives your whole care team one place to track what’s happening, who did what, and what comes next.

Coordinate your care team: Add family members, home health aides, and anyone else involved in care. Everyone has the information they need to provide the best care.

Track what matters: Log medications, health vitals, mood, sleep, bathroom visits, and daily activities. Know how your loved one is really doing, without having to bother anyone for updates.

Seamless handoffs: Care doesn’t stop when shifts change. Hyey keeps the handoff clean so nothing gets missed between caregivers.

Built by daughters who lived it. Hyey was born from personal experience navigating aging parent care while working full time.

Download Hyey and bring your care team together.
